title: Physical health in young males and risk of chronic musculoskeletal, cardiovascular, and respiratory diseases by middle age: A population-based cohort study.
authors: Turkiewicz A, Magnusson K, Timpka S, Kiadaliri A, Dell'Isola A, Englund M.
figures: Fitted incidence proportion by measures of physical health.  Marginal estimates from the adjusted Poisson regression model. All exposures (the 6 variables in the figure, height, drug use, smoking, alcohol consumption, overall health, headache, and gastrointestinal problems) were included in the model and they were also adjusted for parental education and occupation.
